_doc: Ready-to-land EN+DE catalog entries for the hard-coded English lines of today's product runs (result-progress.md section C). Each entry names the call site that prints the English text now and the placeholders its call must pass. Library entries go to 🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/📚️library/🏗️build/📖️texts/🔣️.json (sayBuildV1); framework process entries need a catalog beside their module (pattern: 🎛️owned-execution/🧬️schema/📣️heartbeat.json).
